summary.text: David Mathis is the Republican candidate for the Illinois State Senate, District 27, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Carina Santa Maria for a seat with no incumbent.
Ballotpedia says he was born in Chicago and spent nine years in the U.S. Marine Corps and 14 years in the U.S. Army National Guard.

paragraphs.text: David Mathis was born in Chicago, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his career experience as working as a security professional and notes an affiliation with the American Legion.
In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired veteran and not a career politician.
Mathis advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.
In the survey, he listed restoring fiscal responsibility, putting public safety first and giving the people a voice as his key messages, and said he opposes unsubstantiated tax increases.
